The [validation checklist](https://trinitymetrics.com/references/Validation_Checklist.pdf)
written with Oliver Sander covers planning, risk assessment, and checks on
importing data, modifying data and results. It was written for code a person
wrote and a second person reviews. When an AI agent writes all the code, some
of those checks still apply as written and some rest on assumptions that no
longer hold. This project works out which is which and what has to be added.
Nothing is settled yet.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). The goal, what the existing
